changes: AI assistants can now connect by signing in with Google and tapping Allow, as well as with a personal link. The Privacy Policy explains what this stores and how to disconnect.
Connecting an assistant this way creates an account if you don't have one yet, even without the app.
Clearer about sign-in and deletion: Google also gives us the web address of your profile picture, and after you delete your account we keep only its random identifier and the deletion date.
From November 17, if you haven't seen them: optional Cloud Sync, AI and voice assistants, storage limits, fair use and how to delete your account.
